main.description: A meyasuat box owner's settings. Its existence also marks that the owner has a box. One per repo.

notifyEnabled.description: Whether DM notifications are enabled. Defaults to false when absent.

shareHandleEnabled.description: Whether the owner's handle is shared when they ask questions. Defaults to false when absent.

requireNamedEnabled.description: Whether questions to this box require a signed-in (named) sender. Defaults to false when absent.
